methods.name: Bioinformatic analysis

methods.name: Luciferase reporter assay
methods.protocol_description: YAP/TAZ activity was measured using a synthetic YAP/TAZ-responsive luciferase reporter (4xGTIIC-lux) in MDA-MB-231 and HeLa cells.

methods.name: Immunofluorescence

provenance.text_excerpt: By immunofluorescence on MEC and human mesenchymal stem cells (MSC, an established non-epithelial cellular model for mechanoresponses5,6), YAP/TAZ were clearly nuclear on hard substrates but became predominantly cytoplasmic on softer substrates (Fig. 1b and Supplementary Figs 6 and 7).

results.value_raw_text: YAP/TAZ were nuclear on hard substrates and predominantly cytoplasmic on softer substrates in MEC and MSC.

provenance.text_excerpt: The activity of YAP/TAZ in cells grown on stiff hydrogels (15–40 kPa) was comparable to that of cells grown on plastics, whereas growing cells on soft matrices (in the range of 0.7–1 kPa) inhibited YAP/TAZ activity to levels comparable to short interfering RNA (siRNA)-mediated YAP/TAZ depletion (Fig. 1a and data not shown).

results.value_raw_text: YAP/TAZ activity in cells on stiff hydrogels (15-40 kPa) was comparable to plastic; on soft matrices (0.7-1 kPa) activity was inhibited to levels comparable to siRNA-mediated YAP/TAZ depletion.
